name: READY TO BE SEEN N.1
location: BIASA Art Ubud
description: The first in a planned series of nine exhibitions, the READY TO BE SEEN N.1 showcase at BIASA Art Ubud brings together the works of Jasmine Ansori and Josephine Kingsley, two artists living and working in Bali whose practices explore memory, perception, materiality, and the subtle traces left by experience. Running from 1 September to 15 November 2026 , the READY TO BE SEEN N.1 exhibition forms part of the ongoing commitment of BIASA Art to giving artists new to the public eye a platform to present their work. It encourages visitors to engage with new practices at accessible price points, creating an opportunity for those who connect with a work to take their first step into collecting or commissioning art. Born in 1997 and educated in Fine Arts at the Bandung Institute of Technology (ITB), Jasmine Ansori is a multidisciplinary artist whose practice moves between fine art, graphic design, and digital media. Her work is driven by research, experimentation, and an interest in imagery capable of triggering emotion and evoking a feeling of liminality.

name: Ivan Yanakov in Concert: A Bali Children Foundation Fundraiser at Padma Resort Legian
location: Padma Resort Legian
description: On Saturday, 3 October 2026, A Night With Purpose will unfold in the Plumeria Grand Ballroom, Padma Resort Legian. This magical evening is a one-of-a-kind fundraising dinner for Bali Children Foundation, a gala dinner and concert featuring internationally-acclaimed pianist, Ivan Yanakov. This will be an evening of elegance, featuring wines and canapés, a seated dinner in the ballroom, accompanied by the world-class piano recital. Ivan Yanakov, also an acclaimed conductor, has performed in more than 3o countries, and most recently recorded Rachmaninoff’s Piano Concerto No. 3 with the London Symphony Orchestra. The musician returns to Bali for this special occasion, bringing with him a musical programme inspired by his Bulgarian roots, set to perform works by Dobrinka Tabakova and Pancho Vladigerov, as well as more recognisable pieces from Chopin, Gershwin and Rachmaninoff. Of course, A Night With Purpose is centred on raising funds for Bali Children Foundation, namely youth empowerment programmes in North Bali, including the development of the Angela Wheelton Youth Centre, named after BCF’s late Australian Director.

name: IGNITE 2026
location: Green School Bali
description: On Saturday, 3 October 2026 , Green School Foundation’s fundraising gala, IGNITE , returns for its eighth edition. This prestigious annual event is a cultural and culinary spectacle, taking place at the world-renowned campus of Green School Bali . IGNITE 2026 presents the theme ‘ Chronicles of Nusantara’ , celebrating Indonesia’s land, traditions and living heritage. As such, the gala dinner’s feast will be curated by none other than Indonesia’s culinary ambassador, Chef William Wongso , known for his expertise with archipelagic flavours and recipes. He will be joined by Chef Jero Yudi from Dapur Bali Mula, a Balinese chef renowned for his traditional dishes using local ingredients. The Green School Foundation’s mission is to empower the next generation of environmental leaders. Their work encompasses Environmental School Projects , bringing sustainability education programmes to local schools, as well as providing Agricultural University Scholarships for children of farmers, ensuring a resilient future for Indonesia’s agricultural industry. Through ‘Chronicles of Nusantara’, this year’s IGNITE will draw the connection between land and culture – that the rice on our plates, bamboo for homes, fibres for textiles all originate from Indonesia’s diverse landscape and those who tend them.

name: AMICI Presents: An Exclusive Evening with Chef Enrico Bartolini
location: AMICI by Enrico Bartolini
description: This October, AMICI by Enrico Bartolini in Seminyak will welcome its visionary founder, Chef Enrico Bartolini, for an intimate evening of Italian cuisine, fine wine and convivial dining. Held on Sunday, 4 October 2026, the one-night culinary collaboration brings Chef Enrico together with AMICI’s Chef Alessandro D’Amico for a special five-course dinner. The evening begins with a canapé reception from 6pm to 7pm , before guests take their seats for dinner at 7.30pm . Served across AMICI’s elegant indoor dining room and open-air veranda, the menu will bring together the restaurant’s contemporary interpretation of Italian cuisine with Chef Enrico’s distinctive style. While the full menu will be revealed on the evening, one signature dish has already been unveiled: Risotto Enrico Bartolini , the chef’s celebrated beetroot “Acquerello” risotto, finished with butter, Gorgonzola and walnuts. The collaboration is designed not simply as a progression of courses, but as a meeting of culinary perspectives, with technique, tradition and personal expression at the heart of the experience.

description: October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, also known as ‘ Pinktober ’, a global health campaign that draws crucial attention to this life-threatening disease, promotes education, and encourages early detection. Bali Pink Foundation invites you to join its fundraising charity walk on Saturday, 17 October 2026. Founded in 2013 by breast cancer survivor Gaye Warren, Bali Pink Ribbon Foundation has since screened and provided treatment to thousands of women across Indonesia. Throughout the year, the foundation organises regular breast cancer awareness programmes and breast screenings for local communities in Bali and beyond. ‘Steps of Hope’ , in collaboration with Sudamala Resort Sanur , is the foundation’s annual fundraising event. This ‘Pink Charity Fun Walk and Run’ brings people together for a morning walk in Sanur, fully dressed in pink, to raise awareness of breast cancer in solidarity with the foundation and other survivors.

name: Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF) 2026
location: Taman Baca Ubud
description: Southeast Asia’s biggest literary event, Ubud Writers & Readers Festival (UWRF), returns this 21 to 26 October with a powerful programme of over a hundred separate events. For its 23rd year, authors, thinkers, journalists, poets and more will descend upon Ubud for a week of insight and intrigue. The theme this year is ‘Samarasā: Awareness. Empathy. Action.’, which will guide UWRF’s main programme’s many curated conversations and panels. 150 of the region’s most current, exciting writers will discuss the transformative power of storytelling and its ability to mobilise and enlighten individuals, communities and humanity. As always, the UWRF festival carefully selects its Main Programme speakers, whose works, knowledge and life experiences add poignance, depth and reality into each year’s discussions. A highly-anticipated speaker is Tari Lang , author of the memoir ‘ My Neighbour, The Dictator,’ in which she recounts her life as a fourteen-year-old girl in 1965 when General Suharto’s coup saw her parents imprisoned without trial, and how this history continues to shape who she is.
